tasks.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones)
tasks.content: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 take off together to 22 meters altitude. Drone 1 flies to target Polygon Target 1, Drone 2 flies to target Circle Target 4, and Drone 3 flies to target Circle Target 2. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 64m, then south for 51m, then north for 40m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 64m, south 51m, north 40m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
content_aliases: Coordinate Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3: ascend together to 22 meters altitude, send Drone 1 to target Polygon Target 1, Drone 2 to target Circle Target 4, and Drone 3 to target Circle Target 2, then execute coordinated sweep movement west 64m, south 51m, and north 40m. All drones must complete the full directional distance (west 64m, south 51m, north 40m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Three-drone target sweep operation: launch Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 to altitude 22m, navigate to targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 4, Circle Target 2 respectively, then shift west by 64 meters, south by 51 meters, and north by 40 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute three-drone sweep mission: Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 3 take off reaching 22 meters height, fly to targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 4, Circle Target 2 respectively, then proceed west for 64m, subsequently south for 51m, and finally north for 40m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Three-drone coordinated target mission: Drone 1, Drone 2, and Drone 3 lift off to 22m elevation, reach targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 4, Circle Target 2 respectively, then travel west 64 meters, south 51 meters, and north 40 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
